accepted_assumptions: Source-target transport explicitly limited to an exploratory external adult scenario
Zanzibar arithmetic mean/SD labels and units correct; age restriction and extreme-value selection retained
Lognormal shape, within-stratum age independence, upper age support and sex mean adaptation are labelled assumptions
Ashanti Spearman is not silently relabelled Pearson or adjusted correlation; common copula conversion labelled
Four known weighted comparators retain known_mismatch and null difference by declaration
Adjusted category contrasts remain unavailable in both feedback routes; strict unavailable is not upgraded
Individual SD is not converted to source SE; CIs not used as acceptance bands
PTS current ranges are diagnostic only; no extra target clipping or hidden exclusions declared
limitations: Curator packets were checked as admitted provenance, not independently authenticated against unavailable full texts
No extraction audit certifies cross-population utility or identifies requested target conditional associations
No generated execution or final scientific outcome was reviewed
Initial reviewed metadata and code are bound to the recorded freeze; future submitted revisions require a separate stage entry.

generator_review.method: Static frozen code read plus independent deterministic algebra from spec; no module import, execution, RNG, generated rows or output statistics
generator_review.variance_formula: For female fraction q and difference delta, b=q*(1-q)*delta^2 and E(mu_sex^2)=m^2+b; log_variance=log((m^2+s^2)/(m^2+b)). Total variance=expm1(log_variance)*(m^2+b)+b=s^2.
limits: Source marginal Spearman becomes common within-age/sex Gaussian copula only through explicit transport assumptions
Exact age is independent of lipids/BMI inside the two strata as declared; no source evidence establishes that joint law
HDL>TC is possible under separate positive lognormal variables; code does not silently repair/drop such rows
No finite-sample output agreement or target utility was assessed
